findings.message: The code has two rules for "has no owner", and they disagree. `needsOf` calls a proposal unassigned only when both `ownerUserId` and `ownerName` are null. The pin offer in `pin-offers.ts` (`proposalGated` adds "Make me the owner" when `!p.ownerUserId`) and the Delivery agent in `agent.ts` (raises Suggested owner when `!p.owner_user_id`) look at `owner_user_id` alone. The accept guard in `proposal-kinds.ts` (`suggestedOwner.apply` refuses only if `row.owner_user_id`) does the same. Migration 0019 leaves every existing hand-made row with `owner_name` set and `owner_user_id` null. A spec row whose sync left `owner_name` set does too. On such a row the list shows a named owner with no Unassigned chip. At the same time the pin and the agent treat it as ownerless, and accepting the suggestion silently replaces the named owner. Fix: move the unassigned rule into `readiness.ts` next to `isReadyToVerify`, and use it in `needsOf`, `proposalGated`, the agent and the `suggestedOwner` guard.
findings.scenario: Proposal CON-005 has owner_name 'Kasun Dias' and owner_user_id null (written before migration 0019). Maya closes its last task. The list shows 'Kasun Dias' and no Unassigned chip. Pinning it offers 'Make me the owner of CON-005'. The agent suggests 'Make Maya Fernando the owner of CON-005', and accepting that passes the guard and overwrites Kasun as owner.

findings.message: Every other write path now refuses a withdrawn proposal: add_proposal_task (guardOpen), reopen_task, move_proposal, update_proposal and set_release_proposals. markTaskDone was edited in this diff but still has no withdrawn check, so a hand-made proposal can be changed after it is withdrawn. Fix: read withdrawn_at and meta, then refuse withdrawn proposals the way reopenTask does, with invalid(`${key} was withdrawn`). Add a variant test over withdrawn by hand, withdrawn by the repo, and open.
findings.scenario: withdraw_proposal CON-H001 with reason 'dropped', then call MCP mark_task_done {key:'CON-H001', task:'T1'}. Result: the task is closed, tasks_done and updated_at change on the withdrawn proposal, delivery.task.done is emitted, and the owner gets the bell 'Task T1 of CON-H001 is done'. Expected: the call is refused, as add_proposal_task and reopen_task are.

findings.message: On the list routes the 'New proposal' chat suggestion has no permission check (`when: !isKey(p)`). The page's own New proposal button is gated on canEver(delivery:proposal:create), and the PROJECT route checks the permission too. Fix: gate this suggestion on canEver(v, 'delivery:proposal:create') so it can't disagree with the button.
findings.scenario: Leadership opens /delivery/proposals and chat suggests 'New proposal'. The page shows no button, and the write is refused only after the person starts it.

findings.message: The 'reopen within a day' window is written twice. proposalOffers uses SQL `t.done_at > now() - interval '1 day'` (database clock) and taskOffers uses `Date.now() - doneAt < 24h` (app clock). reopenTask itself has no window. The proposal pin and the task-row pin can disagree near the boundary or when the clocks differ. Fix: keep the window in one helper and read one clock.

A segment that isn't a phase goes through `decodeURIComponent(p.phase)` here, in pageLabel and in ProposalsPage. A malformed escape throws URIError, which gives a server error instead of 'Proposal not found'. Fix: catch the URIError and treat the segment as an unknown key.
findings.scenario: GET /delivery/proposals/%E0%A4 -> URIError -> error page, not 'Proposal not found'.
